scope: Six prospectively labelled synthetic planner requests, each submitted once to each named provider. Only the current learner message, preceding synthetic tutor context and ordinary app planning state reach a provider. Teaching policy v2.1. No tutor generation, review or classroom observation.
budgetRule: Lock the original study budget. Reserve the full per-call cap durably before each dispatch. Measure listed input cost on provider usage; retain the whole reservation when unavailable. Never resubmit an already reserved input or retry a failed call. Stop the segment on billing or authentication failure.
schedule: Cases in listed order; Jev then Gemini in each pair. All requests sequential. Space Google dispatches by at least 15 seconds to reduce burst quota errors.
assessment: Interface opportunity passes when the application offers the labelled component for creation. A no-quiz cue also requires the offer to exclude assessed activities. Both controls require no interface offer. Expected response due is independently compared to the semantic learner_response_due feature. The direct fact also records whether the plain-reply decision is true. Unknown or incomplete provider outcomes are unscored. All offered alternatives, conditional question instructions and projected plan fields are retained; no plan proves a tutor asked or released anything.

cases.context: A jar holds five red beads and two yellow ones. I am about to draw one bead without looking.
cases.label: prediction

cases.context: Two identical toy cars start at the same time. One rolls down a steep ramp and the other down a gentle ramp.
cases.label: prediction

cases.context: A lamp is connected to a variable resistor. The voltage stays fixed and the meter shows how much current flows as the resistance changes.
cases.learner: I want to change this, and see what happens.
cases.label: manipulation

cases.context: A printer makes 12 pages per minute. Its speed and the time it runs determine how many pages come out.
cases.learner: Let me play with the numbers. No quiz for now.
cases.label: manipulation

cases.learner: In one short sentence, how many sides does a hexagon have? Just the answer.
cases.label: direct fact

cases.learner: I want to change my password, and see my account
cases.label: account support
